name: @appbana/engine-contract
description: AppBana Genesis runtime engine contract — the executable form of ADR-013. Exports the RuntimeEngine interface, the closed EffectDescriptor union, ExecutionContext, EngineResult, Diagnostic, the canonical TraceEvent type, and a conformance suite that mechanically proves determinism, purity, effect-union membership, trace-event schema conformance, and mandated-event completeness for any engine implementation.
